name: What is involved in a full kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a full kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen renovation with AKN Design Group involves a comprehensive transformation, from initial design planning to the final walkthrough. This managed process typically includes redesigning the layout for improved circulation and functionality, updating custom cabinetry, selecting quartz or natural-stone countertops, installing new flooring, updating appliances, and coordinating all lighting, plumbing fixtures, and finish selections. We focus on creating a brighter, more efficient kitchen with increased storage and better prep space, tailored for both everyday use and entertaining. Our integrated design-build approach ensures a single point of coordination for all aspects of the project, enhancing functionality, beauty, and long-term value.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full kitchen renovation involves a comprehensive transformation from design to final walkthrough, including layout changes, new cabinetry, countertops, flooring, appliances, and all finish selections.
